  Alison King, Director of Health and Human Services, deferred her report this month
  to ensure sufficient time for the Board to engage on Agenda Item 4, their Board
  Goals and Infrastructure item.

3.  24-52371  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the City’s legislative agenda.

  Ms. King took a moment to share the following information with the Board regarding
  the public health section of the City’s legislative agenda. The primary goals of the
  agenda are to:
  • Support policies and legislation that protect and expand the health care
  safety net and improve the health outcomes of Long Beach community
  members.
  • Support equitable distribution of funding from the State and LA County as a
  city-led health jurisdiction.
  • Enhance partnerships with decision makers to increase the likelihood of
  investments.
  • Sustain programs and initiatives that have shown impact in historically
  disenfranchised communities.

  Ms. King also briefly discussed the current ballot initiative, Proposition 1, and how it
  may affect the Health Department.

  The Board briefly discussed issues related to the hiring of qualified mental health
  professionals, and potential options for reaching out to qualified candidates;such as
  reaching out to California State Long Beach University mental health studies
  students through a possible job fair, or through a potential contact with the King
  Drew Magnet High School of Medicine & Science.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Schwerin, seconded by Member Walton, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  8  Sanders, Schwerin, Girgis, Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle, Walton, Clark
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 7  St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis, McNeeley, Tejani, Vaias, Van
  Meeveren

4.  24-52372  Recommendation to discuss the Board’s goals and infrastructure.

  Chair Sanders took a moment to inform the Board of the Health Department’s
  invitation to join staff and walk in the 2024 Long Beach Pride Parade on Sunday,
